en.tagline: Plan film and video shots as AI-generated storyboard panels
en.summary: This skill guides you through storyboarding for film, video, ads, music videos and animation. It gives you shot types, camera angles, camera movement, continuity rules and a panel annotation format. It also shows how to generate each panel with the inference.sh `belt` CLI and stitch the panels into a board.
problem: Planning a video shot by shot is hard to do without a visual plan. Shot types, camera moves and continuity rules are easy to get wrong, and a scene can end up confusing to the viewer.

With this skill, you write a shot list first, then generate one image per shot with a shared style suffix. Each panel carries its shot type, angle, movement, duration, action, dialogue, sound and music notes. You then stitch the panels into rows and a full board.
fit: Pre-production for a short film or video
Ad storyboards and music video planning
Building an animatic or a visual script before filming
unfit: Producing the final video itself, since the skill generates still panels
steps: Write a shot list for each scene, noting shot type, framing and action.
Choose one style suffix (lens, color grade, lighting) and reuse it for every panel.
Generate each panel with `belt app run falai/flux-dev-lora` at the same aspect ratio.
Check continuity: keep the camera on one side of the 180-degree line, match action between cuts, and keep screen direction consistent.
Add the annotations to each panel: shot type, movement, duration, action, dialogue, SFX and music.
Stitch the panels into rows with `belt app run infsh/stitch-images`, then stack the rows into a full board.

zh.tagline: 用AI生成分镜面板，规划影视镜头
zh.summary: 这个技能用于影视、视频、广告、音乐视频和动画的分镜制作。它提供景别、机位角度、运镜、连续性规则和分镜标注格式。它还说明如何用 inference.sh 的 `belt` 命令行工具生成每个分镜画面，并把画面拼成分镜板。
problem: 按镜头逐个规划视频时，如果没有视觉方案，很难把握。景别、运镜和连续性规则容易出错，观众可能看不懂场景关系。
使用这个技能时，你先写出镜头清单，再用同一个风格后缀为每个镜头生成一张画面。每个分镜都标注景别、角度、运动、时长、动作、台词、音效和音乐。之后，你把分镜拼成行，再组成完整的分镜板。
fit: 短片或视频的前期制作
广告分镜和音乐视频规划
拍摄前制作动态分镜或视觉脚本
unfit: 制作最终成片，因为该技能生成的是静态分镜画面
不使用 inference.sh 的 `belt` 命令行工具
steps: 为每场戏写镜头清单，注明景别、构图和动作。
选定一个风格后缀（镜头、调色、光线），并在所有分镜中复用。
用 `belt app run falai/flux-dev-lora` 生成每个分镜，保持相同的画面比例。
检查连续性：机位保持在180度轴线的同一侧，切换镜头时动作要衔接，画面方向要保持一致。
为每个分镜添加标注：景别、运镜、时长、动作、台词、音效和音乐。
用 `belt app run infsh/stitch-images` 把分镜拼成行，再把各行拼成完整的分镜板。
